source.scope: Private observer-only preparation/commit scope and prepared-transaction admission wait; no lifetime/order/ownership/limits changes.

excluded_observer_v1.reason: Nested pin/admission spans ended while acquired authority hold span remained open. Crossed span lifetimes produced invalidSpans; all v1 timing attribution excluded. V2 uses thread/request-bound independent elapsed work counters, preserving original stage tree.

finding: Prepared transaction snapshot registration remains held during final authority admission. Independent measured admission wait occupies~89percent of preparation-to-commit interval on sampled turn.event.record in both frozen original harness paths. Optimize queued prepared lifetime/admission scheduling rather than parser work for this delay.
limitations: Observer-enabled timings, no default-off speedup or original1s acceptance claim.
Elapsed work counters overlap stage durations and each other; never add them as disjoint costs.

Preparation-to-commit is a scoped interval starting after replica build, not an exact registry registration/drop timer. No-transaction results close it early; early returns contribute their measured scope.
Per-request means divide by all sampled operation requests, not an independently counted number of successful pin registrations.
turn.event.record combines stream and terminal events; no separate stream/settle attribution.
No runtime or test code admitted; source is private instrumentation.
No new capacity, lifetime, fairness, durability, ownership, OCC, GC or deadline policy.
Installed third-party dependencies remain shared; project imports and all frozen caller bytes guarded.
